# The Sector Chroma
[color=yellow]The Sector Chroma[/color] is a sector of the Milky-Way Galaxy located a bit too close to Sagittarius A* for anyone's comfort. It's a highly valuable location for all of the companies interested in it, considering the fragility of the Noosphere within it, as well as a variety of valuable resources and knowledge.
Due to the Noospheric instability within the Sector Chroma, phenomena such as anomalies, weird dragons, crossovers between universes, and more occur a lot more frequency here. This has also led to the discovery of [bold][color=yellow]abberrant species[/color][/bold] and their experiences within the concurrent plane.
(The concurrent plane being the specific plane of the Versuis ChromaStation takes place within.)

# Topology
Sector Chroma is home to a massive solar system, believed to be filled with the remnants of an old space-faring society, now extinct at a galactic scale. [italic]Supposedly.[/italic] Cryptids in highly advanced [color=yellow]Fracture gear[/color] have been spotted amongst the wastes of Frostmoon.
Though, those are likely just legends.
Unfortunately, none of the planets within the Sector Chroma are deemed hospitable for NanoTrasen-hired species- with the potential exception of Starreef. Due to this many are used for mass-scale gas or material mining operations. The main celestial objects that NanoTrasen stations use for their material mining operations are known as [color=#ff9652]Lavaland[/color], [color=#73c7ff]Frostmoon[/color], and [color=cyan]Starreef[/color].
## Lavaland
Lavaland is the largest of the telluric planets within the Sector Chroma, and by far the most tectonically active.
Lavaland's crust is highly fragmented, constantly shifting and moving at rates that should not be possible- and yet, it is. Due to this activity, earthquakes are near constant, fault lines will open at random, and volcanic activity is basically a given. The planet is rich in coal, diamonds, iron, uranium, and bananium.
The atmosphere here contains practically no oxygen or nitrogen; instead, it consists primarily of carbon dioxide, methane, chlorofluorocarbons, and nitrogen trifluoride. Internals and hardsuit required.
## Frostmoon
Frostmoon is the largest of Lavaland's moons. It's essentially a highly pressurized cryogenic nightmare, and the bane of every Unathi salvager to exist.
Unlike the planet it orbits, Frostmoon's crust is thick and has little in the way of tectonic plates- in practice, there's only four of them. It has essentially no tectonic activity, partially thanks to the thick atmosphere of frezon, plasma, and argon. Frostmoon is rich in silver, plasma, quartz, salt, and sulfur.
As previously stated, the atmosphere is highly pressurized, over 600 kilopascals, and absolutely freezing. The planet's surface is covered with streaks and seas of liquid plasma, with cryovolcanoes that are relatively active despite the low tectonic activity. Internals and hardsuit required.
## Starreef
Within the Sector Chroma's goldilocks zone is Starreef, an ocean world teeming with life and decorated with two ring systems of ice, rock, and dust. It would be the perfect place to set up on-planet research colonies to study it...
... if it weren't home to leviathan-class predators, lethal disease, an ocean composed of both water and ammonia.
Starreef has no dry land, all of it is contained within an ocean that reaches deeper than Sol-Earth's mariana trench. The planet is relatively calm tectonically, in exchange for vast aquatic mountain ranges, trenches, volcanoes, et cetera. An eutectic, hydrospheric paradise for those that call it home, and a nightmare for anyone that doesn't. It's not particularly rich in any materials- however, bluespace and normality crystals, gold, and the ambiguous illusite.
Fortunately, Starreef's atmosphere is about a 2.5:1 ratio of nitrogen to oxygen, making it comfortable for most species to breathe in. Unfortunately, there's no dry land, and any attempts at on-planet research stations have been destroyed.
Due to the sheer amount Starreef has been researched by the nearby Coalition Empire of the Seki-Sekkan, there's lots of information on Starreef available to the public.
